claim_boundary: Final Code confirmatory materialization. GPT-5.6 Luna supplies offline Q1-Q4 calibration labels and one frozen local ranker processes the full corpus. Normal retains only chunks with at least one independent confident in-distribution Q1-Q4 pass and no qualified fail; abstain, OOD, and low confidence are not selected unless Stage-C Coverage vetoes support extinction. External teachers cannot alter runtime membership. Utility, NLL, benchmark outcomes, source reputation, domain quota, and token budgets are forbidden runtime inputs.
